SELECT itemname= item.name, 
			accname = dbo.accounts.name, 
			packingdesc=item.packingdesc,
			aliasname=item.customicode,  
			manfname=(select name from manufacturer where manfcode=item.manfcode),
			address = dbo.customer.address1,
			address2 = dbo.customer.address2,
			custphone=dbo.customer.phone,
			dayslimit=dbo.customer.dayslimit,
			contactperson=dbo.customer.cp,
			CustomerCode=dbo.accounts.aliasname,
			/*deliveredby=(select name from salesman where salesmancode=issueheader.deliveredby),*/
			CUSTCITY=dbo.customer.city,
			referemceno=issueheader.referenceno,
			salesman = dbo.users.username, 
			issueinvcode = dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode, 
			headerno = dbo.issueheader.headerno,
			headerinvno = dbo.issueheader.headerinvno,  
         date = dbo.issueheader.date,   
        /* invdiscperc = dbo.issueheader.discperc,   
         misccharges = dbo.issueheader.misccharges,  
         flatdisc = dbo.issueheader.flatdisc,   
         invsalestax = dbo.issueheader.salestax, */  
         dbo.issueheader.acccode,
 				
			dbo.issueheader.remarks,	
         gcode = issuedetail.gcode,   
         icode = issuedetail.icode,   
         batch = issuedetail.batch,   
         expiry = issuedetail.expiry,   
			looseqty = isnull(issuedetail.qty,0),
			
		
			packunits= issuedetail.packunits,
	 		saleprice= issuedetail.saleprice,
	 
			itempacking = itempacking.name,
			itemdescription = issuedetail.itemdescription,	
			Godown =Godown.name,
			Id       = issuedetail.IDENTITYCOL 

    FROM issueheader, 
			issuedetail, 
			accounts, 
			customer,
			users, 
			Item 
			LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemPacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN Godown ON (dbo.item.GCode = dbo.Godown.GCode)
 
   WHERE ( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = :ar_issueinvcode ) AND
			( dbo.issueheader.issueinvcode = dbo.issuedetail.issueinvcode) AND
			( dbo.issueheader.acccode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
			( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
			( dbo.issueheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND 
			( dbo.issuedetail.icode = dbo.item.icode) 

ORDER BY dbo.issuedetail.IDENTITYCOL
